**1.028: Notes, and Falafel coming soon.**

- **Notes:** a notepad you dictate into with the in-app mic, kept on the phone only. A note you leave untitled gets a title from the title model; a title you type is never replaced. Not yet tested on a phone.
- **Falafel:** the new model for short voice commands is listed under Models, in a full size and a small one (Falafel-Parakeet-110M). It shows "Coming soon" until its first version is published, then downloads like any other model, with no app update.
- **Floating mic:** its bar now opens across the screen unless you picked a direction.
- arm64-v8a only. Android 9+. Downloads: [hebrish.app/download](https://hebrish.app/download).
